refusals.invalid_expiry: The time a card stops being good is Unix seconds, nine to eleven digits.
refusals.invalid_name: The name is a hint the readers may keep the scope under: 1 to 32 letters, digits, dots, underscores and dashes, starting with a letter or a digit. It can be left out.
refusals.a_key_not_an_address: That has the shape of a key, and a key is never shown: anyone who saw or photographed the code could read with it. Give the scope's write address, the 20 characters aamio scope list shows (aamio_scopes over MCP).
refusals.not_a_write_address: Give the write address of a scope: exactly 20 characters of a-z and 2-7, as aamio scope list shows it (aamio_scopes over MCP). With no scope for the room yet, make one first with aamio scope new NAME (aamio_scope_new).
